name: mean_residual_life
label: Mean residual life (age only)
what_it_assumes: Every cutter's life is a draw from the same pool, so cycles left depend only on how many cycles it has already survived.

name: ridge
label: Ridge regression
inputs: TCN physics inputs (29: 18 causal relative signals = log of each signal over the cutter's own first clean cycles, 4 absolute vibration-shape stats, first-ring flag, 5 settings, log_age)
what_it_assumes: Cycles left is one weighted sum of today's currents, vibrations, settings and log age, the same straight-line rule for every cutter.

name: elastic_net
label: Elastic net
inputs: TCN physics inputs (29: 18 causal relative signals = log of each signal over the cutter's own first clean cycles, 4 absolute vibration-shape stats, first-ring flag, 5 settings, log_age)
what_it_assumes: Cycles left is a weighted sum of today's inputs in which only a few inputs matter.
size: 18 of 29 weights non-zero (median over folds) + intercept

name: hi_threshold
label: Health indicator + failure threshold
inputs: table motor current relative to new, last W cycles; training lives for the fallback
what_it_assumes: The cutter dies when the table motor current reaches a fixed level, and its recent trend continues smoothly until it gets there.
size: 3 numbers (failure level 0.75-0.79 as log ratio, window, trend form)

name: knn_similarity
label: Trajectory similarity (k nearest stretches)
inputs: last W cycles of table current, spindle current, table vibration (relative to new)
what_it_assumes: A cutter whose recent current and vibration path looks like a past cutter's at some moment has about as many cycles left as that cutter had then.
size: stores 880 training cycles (mean over folds); window W and k chosen

name: random_forest
label: Random forest
inputs: TCN physics inputs (29: 18 causal relative signals = log of each signal over the cutter's own first clean cycles, 4 absolute vibration-shape stats, first-ring flag, 5 settings, log_age)
what_it_assumes: Cycles left is a step function of today's inputs alone; averaging many trees learned on resampled cycles smooths the steps.
size: 300 trees, 26773 leaves in total (mean over folds)

name: lgbm_plain
label: LightGBM, TCN inputs (control)
inputs: TCN physics inputs (29: 18 causal relative signals = log of each signal over the cutter's own first clean cycles, 4 absolute vibration-shape stats, first-ring flag, 5 settings, log_age)
what_it_assumes: Cycles left is a sum of many small step functions of today's inputs alone.

name: lgbm_history
label: LightGBM + hand-made history
inputs: TCN physics inputs (29) + mean and slope over the last 5 and 15 cycles of the 18 causal relative signals + highest table current so far (102)
what_it_assumes: Today's inputs plus simple summaries of the last 5-15 cycles (levels, trends, worst table current so far) say how close the cutter is to breaking.

name: lgbm_summaries
label: LightGBM, 120 summaries (control)
inputs: 120 released summaries (raw per-cycle min/max/mean/std/skew/kurtosis of 8 accelerometers and 12 motor currents, not relative to new) + 5 settings + log_age (126)
what_it_assumes: Cycles left is a sum of many small step functions of today's raw signal statistics, settings and age.

name: lgbm_history_summaries
label: LightGBM + history, 120 summaries
inputs: 120 released summaries (raw per-cycle min/max/mean/std/skew/kurtosis of 8 accelerometers and 12 motor currents, not relative to new) + 5 settings + log_age + mean and slope over the last 5 and 15 cycles and highest value so far of the 6 summaries with most split gain on the training cutters (156)
what_it_assumes: Today's raw signal statistics plus the recent level, trend and worst-so-far of the few most telling ones say how close the cutter is to breaking.
size: 400 trees x up to 15 leaves; history on: Current - Driving axle X L2 - mean (13/13); Current - Driving axle X L1 - mean (13/13); Accelerometer - Spindle -Z - std (13/13); Accelerometer - Spindle -X - std (9/13); Accelerometer - X Driving axle +Z - std (8/13); Accelerometer - Y Driving axle +Y - mean (8/13); Current - Driving axle X L3 - mean (4/13); Accelerometer - X Driving axle +Z - mean (2/13)

name: svr
label: Support vector regression (RBF)
inputs: TCN physics inputs (29: 18 causal relative signals = log of each signal over the cutter's own first clean cycles, 4 absolute vibration-shape stats, first-ring flag, 5 settings, log_age)
what_it_assumes: Cycles left is a smooth function of today's inputs, built from the training cycles most similar to today's.
size: 700 support vectors (mean over folds) x 28-29 inputs

name: gaussian_process
label: Gaussian process
inputs: 5 settings, log age, 6 physics signals relative to new (12)
what_it_assumes: Cutters with similar settings, age and current/vibration levels have similar cycles left, and cycles left changes smoothly as those inputs change.
size: 880 stored training cycles + one kernel length per input + 2

name: lgbm_quantile
label: LightGBM quantiles (10/50/90%)
inputs: TCN physics inputs (29: 18 causal relative signals = log of each signal over the cutter's own first clean cycles, 4 absolute vibration-shape stats, first-ring flag, 5 settings, log_age)
what_it_assumes: Today's inputs fix not just the likely cycles left but its spread, learned directly as the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles.
size: 3 x 400 trees x up to 15 leaves
